chapter_title_en: The Creation Stance Shocks the Realm
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 572: The Creation Stance Shocks the Realm - Ji Ning vs. Daofather Puppet
chapter_meta_description: The Evergreen Sword Immortal's Daofather Puppet is humbled! Ji Ning unleashes the ultimate 'Creation' stance, forcing the enemy's ultimate weapon to its knees and stunning the watching cosmos in the Realm War.
og_title: A Stance that Creates Worlds! Ji Ning's 'Creation' Breaks a Daofather Puppet
og_description: The ultimate clash of the Realm War begins! Ji Ning's top-tier Karmic Punishment Deity clashes with the Daofather Puppet, and a single, earth-shattering sword stroke sends the enemy's ultimate weapon crashing to its knees.
twitter_title: Ji Ning just kneecapped a Daofather-level puppet. The entire cosmos just went silent.
twitter_description: In the latest chapter of Desolate Era, Ji Ning's long-hidden 'Creation' stance shatters the Evergreen Sword Immortal's arrogance and drives the Daofather Puppet to the ground.

lore_anchors.definition: A True Immortal of the Three Realms, known for his cold, self-centered cruelty and control over a Daofather Puppet.
A supreme war construct possessing Daofather-level strength and extreme toughness, virtually indestructible except by a Daofather's personal effort.
Colossal battle avatars formed from coordinated immortal cultivator formations.
A fusion form of seven Empyrean Gods, granting absolute control over its power.
The highest tier of Ki Refiner in the Grand Xia, a perfected immortal with immense power.
The ultimate sword-art of Immortal Beixing, perfected by Ji Ning into twelve stances.
The final, ultimate stance of the Three-Foot Sword, invoking Pangu's act of creating the universe.
A primordial True God who mastered the Heavenly Daos of Yang and Annihilation.
Daoist Zhuang Zhou, an ancient True God and a top power in the Daoist faith.
The third of the Three Sovereigns, a supreme ancient power who taught humanity agriculture.
A realm's accumulated destiny and luck, a core strategic objective in Realm Wars.

cultural_notes_faq.a: It's a supreme war construct with the raw power of a Daofather, piloted by a single True Immortal who has absolute, headache-free control over all its might.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why was everyone so shocked that Ji Ning overpowered it?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The top-tier Karmic Punishment Deity has more total theoretical power, but it's notoriously hard to control—most pilots can only use a sliver of its potential.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Who are the Buddhas and Daoists watching at the beginning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The supreme leaders of the Three Realms: Tathagata (Buddhism) and the Three Purities (Daoism), along with their pantheons and other ancient figures like the Divine Farmer.
